processing.window: [-300,0) and [0,300) seconds relative to each dataset boundary; offset records boundary minus injection time
processing.answer: Filter mean load after <= before, then maximize positive absolute latency mean difference. Original finite samples; no interpolation. Windows curated for at least two eligible positive increases and a larger ineligible distractor; not representative sampling.
processing.display: 5-second non-overlapping arithmetic means; all plots share relative comparison time.
processing.units: CPU, latency, load, memory and error retain original source scale; no P95, percent, RPS or millisecond interpretation is asserted.
processing.missing: Null values excluded from means; task candidates require >=90% observed sample coverage in both windows.
processing.event: Known fault injection time, not a deployment and not evidence of a causal effect.
